project_name: Workz Ventures - Enhanced AI-Driven Buyer & Marketing Agency
vibe: Bloomberg Terminal meets a high-end strategy consultancy. Editorial typography, data-dense layouts, intentional incompleteness, functional minimalism, highly confident, premium, and professional.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-medium font-headings
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium font-headings
rules.overline: uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-mono text-text_tertiary

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room Grid' for Dashboards, 'F-pattern hierarchy' for scanning data.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize full height (`h-full`).
layout_and_spacing.border_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Container: `border-collapse`. Items: subtle borders (`border-r border-b border-border`).
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense inside widgets (`p-4` or `p-6`) to maximize data visibility. Generous padding around the main dashboard container (`p-8` to `p-12`).

components.cards_and_widgets: Flat background (`bg-surface`), sharp corners or max 4px radius (`rounded-sm`), 1px subtle border (`border-border`), no shadow. On hover, slight lift and border color brightens to `border-text_tertiary`.
components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (`rounded-sm`). Primary CTA: `bg-primary text-primary_foreground hover:bg-gray-200`. Secondary: `border border-border text-white hover:bg-surface_hover`. Danger/Action: `text-accent_amber border-accent_amber`.
components.tables_and_data: Dense layout. Use monospace (`JetBrains Mono`) for all numbers, IDs, and financial metrics. Left-aligned text, right-aligned metrics. Subdued header text using overline typography.
components.forms_and_inputs: Minimalist inputs. `bg-transparent border-b border-border` or strict boxed inputs with `border-border`. No heavy glows, just a crisp 1px highlight on focus.
components.navigation_sidebar: Solid dark background (`bg-background`). High contrast active states with a 2px left border using `border-primary` or `border-accent_brand`. Overline text for category groups.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Text brightness increases, border contrast increases. No bouncy animations.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use `transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out` for UI elements.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Terminal-style loading. Use monospace percentage counters or subtle linear progress bars at the top of cards, rather than generic spinning circles.

icons_and_assets.style: Regular or Light weight for dashboard density. Use sharp, un-rounded icons if possible.

login_background.description: Architectural high-end dark institutional building structure. Use this for the Auth/Login page as an immersive side-panel.

newsletter_cover.description: Premium black textured paper with subtle gold line. Use this in the Marketing Collateral Generator and Newsletter Center as a cover/placeholder for generated assets.

avatars.description: Executive portrait for Buyer profiles or Leadership Insights
Executive portrait for Lead Nurturing pipelines
Executive portrait for Agent Activity Monitor or Audit Logs

critical_testing_rules.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="buyer-kpi-aum"`). This is mandatory for automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark theme and avoid pure black or pure gray. Use the provided tinted `#08080A` and `#121316`.
Do not use purple or teal gradients. Use flat solid colors for all UI elements. Color is functional.
Implement 'Grid Borders' style for dashboard layouts: expose the structure. Do not overuse isolated floating cards; prefer a unified grid.
All numbers, stats, and financial metrics MUST use `JetBrains Mono` font.
For headings, strictly use `Cabinet Grotesk` and apply `tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all buttons, links, inputs, and major data points.
For the MCP Actions Console and Agent Activity Monitor, adopt a heavily terminal-inspired look (Monospace text, green/amber status indicators).
For the Marketing/Newsletter pages, lean into the 'Jewel & Luxury' archetype (use `Cabinet Grotesk`, generous spacing, and the `newsletter_cover` image).
